headlines.text: Back on this day in 2023, MJF vs. Kenny Omega put the AEW World Heavyweight Title on the line, appearing on Collision, rated 9.10 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype. It was the 40th time the AEW World Heavyweight Title had been on the line, a real landmark for that championship. It marked MJF's 10th match with the title on the line. In their first-ever encounter, MJF broke Kenny Omega's 346-day reign record by retaining the AEW World Title through a Panama Sunrise and a heatseeker piledriver in a match both men later shook hands after.

That Wednesday in 2020, Kenny Omega vs. Penta El Zero M met in a Tournament Match, in the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 8.14 ? a real highlight of the night. A highlight-reel semifinal ? Penta stepped in as a late replacement for his injured brother Rey Fenix, and the two delivered real fireworks (including a Canadian Destroyer off the middle turnbuckle) before Omega advanced to face Hangman Page in the tournament final.
On this day in 2022, Matt Taven announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance against Wardlow, appearing on Rampage, rated 4.75.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2023, when Hikaru Shida vs. Abadon fought tooth and nail for the AEW Women's World Title in a Fright Night Fight match, appearing on Collision, rated 6.25. It marked Hikaru Shida's 20th match with the title on the line.
On a Wednesday in 2020, back when Leyla Hirsch arrived in AEW against Serena Deeb, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.39.
It was 2020 when Adam Page vs. Wardlow met in a Tournament Match, opening the card on Dynamite, rated 7.19 ? a good, competitive contest.
